teaser: A toolbox left open on the back step says something before you do. Life path 1 and ISTP meet here: both want the hands on the problem, not the committee around it. The 1 asks for a life answerable to your own authority, not someone else's plan. ISTP already moves that way, working a thing until it gives up its secret, then walking off once it is fixed. Crossed, the two do not need convincing of each other — what gets smaller is the chance anyone else gets handed the wrench.
excerpt: Fixing things stands in for saying things, more often than not.
